notes: Region catalogue from docs/program/CSD-BRAIN-REGIONS.md. `live` reflects what is IMPLEMENTED, not what is intended; `pretrain.available` reflects what is ON DISK, not what is named. Both default to false so that intent can be recorded without it reading as capability. Curriculum order is mandatory: per-region pretrain -> router -> assembled mind -> foundation. Foundation corpora (FineWeb/C4/Pile) are step 4, not step 1.

regions.name: residual_mlp
regions.role: Residual update on the shared [B, D] stream; keeps the residual path competent.

pretrain.notes: Synthetic tokens only via train-route. No public corpus bound yet.

regions.name: stream_vae
regions.role: Encode / reparameterize / decode. The compress analog in the PoC.
regions.router_trigger: Stream that wants reconstruction or quantization.

pretrain.notes: Honest stored-byte ratios ~1.3-2.7x in STATUS.md. Not 10x.

regions.name: language
regions.role: Language centre. Docstring <-> function, search and generation (specialisation: code -- its current corpus and battery are code-flavoured; the faculty is not domain-scoped). Explicitly NOT next-token over all of GitHub.
regions.router_trigger: language=python and a docstring is present.

pretrain.notes: NOT on disk. /pretrain/code/codesearchnet holds only metadata.json; download-status.json shows 2 of 6 sets completed. MBPP and HumanEval are eval, not pretrain. Legacy region id `code` (see cogsyndelta.regions.aliases) -- on-disk corpus paths, matrix cell dirs, and the Hub repo still use that spelling until their own follow-ups land.

NOT on disk. SciFact and NFCorpus are eval-only per license (NC / ToS) and must not be trained on. MERGED (DEC-02, W4, docs/design/REGION-TAXONOMY-AND-INTERCONNECT.md row W4) into `memory`'s retrieval head -- see this entry's own `merged_into`. Kept readable for old receipts (e.g. the 2026-09-02 FiQA BEIR-pool receipt W4's own gates compare against); not retrained standalone after W4 lands.

regions.name: compress
regions.role: Neighbors stay neighbors in a short latent.
regions.router_trigger: Sentence pair or embedding to reconstruct.

pretrain.notes: NOT on disk. WikiText-2 is later-assembly reconstruction, not first pretrain. MERGED (DEC-02, W4, docs/design/REGION-TAXONOMY-AND-INTERCONNECT.md row W4) into `memory`'s consolidation head -- see this entry's own `merged_into`. Kept readable for old receipts (e.g. the 2026-09-02 STS-B/AllNLI receipt W4's own gates compare against); not retrained standalone after W4 lands.

regions.name: memory
regions.router_trigger: Sentence pair or embedding to reconstruct (consolidation); a query plus candidate passages (retrieval) -- both routed to the same trunk (DEC-02).

pretrain.corpus: union of compress's all-nli/pair training corpus and retrieve's fiqa+natural-questions+gooaq (region_spec('memory'), scripts/csd-train-all.py), graded on stsb-validation (consolidation) and the BEIR FiQA full-pool eval (retrieval, cogsyndelta.eval.beir_fiqa)
pretrain.notes: NOT on disk. DEC-02: one hippocampal faculty, one shared trunk (TextEncoder), two evaluation heads -- consolidation (compress's graded STS-B gate) and retrieval (retrieve's BEIR full-pool gate) read off the SAME pooled embedding space, not two separate projection layers. Row W4 (docs/design/REGION-TAXONOMY-AND-INTERCONNECT.md): DESIGNED AS THE FIRST TOKEN-AWARE RETRAIN -- trains with L_token/L_decorr (regions/pretrain.py PretrainConfig.token_loss_weight/decorr_weight) ON. DEC-24: inherits `retrieve`'s token embedding table (the parent whose gate -- the FiQA BEIR pool -- survives as memory's gate); the divergence from `compress`'s table is measured and recorded in the receipt. Merges and retires `compress`+`retrieve`'s standalone training (see their own entries' `merged_into`).

regions.name: visual
regions.role: I-JEPA EMA target encoder over RGB images; maps an image to a [B, D] stream vector. Does not reconstruct pixels and is not a generative decoder.

pretrain.notes: Deployed module is the EMA target encoder (IJEPA.encode / target_encoder.embed). Encoder geometry (image_size, patch_size, dim, depth, n_heads, pos_kind) is on the training receipt's config.jepa, not this row. Mix B pin in config/mind/visual-clean-v1.json. Legacy id `vl_latent`.

regions.name: reason
regions.role: Question <-> worked derivation retrieval: match a question to its own step-by-step solution among candidates. Does NOT generate reasoning steps -- same bi-encoder shape as language/compress/retrieve, trained the same way.
regions.router_trigger: A question paired with a pool of candidate worked solutions to rank (arithmetic or algebraic word problems). Not a trigger for open-ended step generation, which this region cannot do.

pretrain.corpus: gsm8k-main(7473) + aqua_rat-raw sampled to 4982 (seed 0, docs/design/CORPUS-CONTRACT.md B4)
pretrain.notes: N_eff ~1.92 (60/40 gsm8k/aqua_rat, capped per CORPUS-CONTRACT.md B1 -- uncapped it was 92.9% aqua_rat, N_eff 1.15), below the >=3 general-capability threshold in Part 3 B2. WAIVER (B2): only 2 licence-clean reasoning-shape sources exist today (arithmetic word problems, algebraic MCQ); deduction and multi-hop-factual shapes have no clean candidate (MATH family DMCA-rejected by the catalogue; HotpotQA is CC-BY-SA and collides with retrieve's Wikipedia lineage). Capability NOT covered: multi-hop / deductive reasoning retrieval. Dated 2026-09-02.

regions.name: classify_banking77
regions.role: Classify a banking-support utterance into one of 77 fine-grained intents. Encoder + softmax cross-entropy head, trained end to end -- NOT a bi-encoder (see regions/classify_pretrain.py's module docstring for why classify does not fit the InfoNCE shape).
regions.router_trigger: Text already believed to be a banking-support query. NO out-of-label-space ('none of these') detector is trained -- routing open-domain text here returns a confident, wrong intent rather than 'unknown'. docs/design/CORPUS-CONTRACT.md 1.5 names this the single most important missing requirement for a router-dispatched classify region.

pretrain.notes: N_eff = 1 (single source), below even the narrow-region >=2 threshold in Part 3 B2. WAIVER: banking77 is the only licence-clean 77-way banking-intent corpus catalogued; no second source identified. Within-source class balance passes B5 (77 classes, max share 1.87%, max:min 5.34:1). Capability NOT covered: no out-of-label-space rejection. Dated 2026-09-02.

regions.name: classify_go_emotions
regions.role: Predict which of 28 emotions (multi-label, including 'neutral') a short text expresses. Encoder + independent per-label BCE head, trained end to end -- NOT a bi-encoder, and NOT the same region as classify_banking77 (incompatible label spaces; see regions/classify_pretrain.py's module docstring).
regions.router_trigger: Text already believed to carry emotional content worth labelling. NO out-of-label-space detector is trained (see classify_banking77's router_trigger for the same caveat).

pretrain.notes: N_eff = 1 (single source; same waiver as classify_banking77 -- no second multi-label emotion corpus catalogued). Also fails within-source balance B5 on its own: largest label ('neutral') is 32.8% of label instances, max:min 184.7:1 (threshold: max 25%, max:min 20:1). NOT rebalanced by resampling -- per B5's own remedy menu ('rebalance ... or declare the region's metric per-class'), this region is instead gated on macro-averaged per-label average precision, which weights every label equally regardless of prevalence, with each label's own chance level (its holdout prevalence) recorded alongside its score. Capability NOT covered: no out-of-label-space rejection. Dated 2026-09-02.
